question: The closure ledger holds 221 paid pathway rows open on legal_review_pending. How many distinct legal decisions is that?

decisionSets.title: Reconfirm counsel ratification for routes whose ratification is no longer current
decisionSets.currentPrimaryAuthority: auth-2026-08-19-owner-legal-approval-completed-output (approved, authorized) plus EXT-ADOPT-01 standing external counsel adoption of 2026-08-08
decisionSets.currentProductTreatment: Packet generation and payment are closed for every row in this set.
decisionSets.exactUnresolvedQuestion: Is counsel's ratification of each of these routes still current against the route contract, the required facts and the official source as they stand today?
decisionSets.whyExistingAuthorityDoesNotResolveIt: The 2026-08-19 owner decision approved the completed output as it stood then, and EXT-ADOPT-01 adopted the legal design in August. Neither says the ratification of these specific routes is current now, and currency is exactly what is being asked.
proposedOptions: Reconfirm the ratification as current, unchanged.
Reconfirm with a named amendment to the route contract or required facts.
Withdraw ratification and route the pathway to a non-packet service outcome.
decisionSets.recommendedProductDecision: Reconfirm as current where the official source and route contract have not moved since ratification, and name an amendment where they have. This is the only set here that should reach the legal team at all.
decisionSets.engineeringDeltaAfterDecision: Record the reconfirmation in the authorization queue and regenerate the join and the closure ledger. No packet or renderer work follows from a clean reconfirmation.
decisionSets.packetGenerationCurrentlyDisabled: 4 of 8 rows do not render today; payment is closed for all 8.

decisionSets.title: Project the existing owner approval onto the pathway rows it already covers
decisionSets.currentPrimaryAuthority: auth-2026-08-19-owner-legal-approval-completed-output (approved, authorized) plus EXT-ADOPT-01 standing external counsel adoption of 2026-08-08
decisionSets.currentProductTreatment: Packet generation and payment are closed for every row in this set.
decisionSets.exactUnresolvedQuestion: None. The question was answered on 2026-08-19 and the answer simply does not reach the pathway projection.
decisionSets.whyExistingAuthorityDoesNotResolveIt: It does resolve it. The closure ledger computes legal_review_pending from a per-pathway projection that the legal join already supersedes, and the two generators disagree.
proposedOptions: Project legalStatus from paid-pathway-legal-join.json into the closure ledger's legallyApprovedPacket stage.
Leave the two ledgers disagreeing and continue reporting an approved corpus as unreviewed.
decisionSets.recommendedProductDecision: Project the join's legalStatus into the closure ledger. One register already holds the decision; the other should read it rather than recompute it.
decisionSets.legalOwner: None. No legal decision is required.
decisionSets.engineeringDeltaAfterDecision: One change in the closure-ledger generator, plus a regeneration. No legal artifact, no schema change.
decisionSets.packetGenerationCurrentlyDisabled: 14 of 41 rows do not render today; payment is closed for all 41.

decisionSets.title: Wire approved pathways to a packet family or track
decisionSets.currentPrimaryAuthority: auth-2026-08-19-owner-legal-approval-completed-output (approved, authorized) plus EXT-ADOPT-01 standing external counsel adoption of 2026-08-08
decisionSets.currentProductTreatment: Packet generation and payment are closed for every row in this set.
decisionSets.exactUnresolvedQuestion: Which packet family does each of these approved pathways resolve to?
decisionSets.whyExistingAuthorityDoesNotResolveIt: The owner's decision approves families, and these pathways reach none. The approval is real; the pathway cannot receive it until the registry connects the two.
proposedOptions: Bind each pathway to an existing approved family in the track registry.
Record the pathway as non-packet service where no family is appropriate.
decisionSets.recommendedProductDecision: Bind to an existing approved family where one fits; otherwise reclassify the pathway as a non-packet service outcome rather than inventing a family.
decisionSets.legalOwner: None yet. Counsel is reached only if the wiring exposes a family outside the approved corpus.
decisionSets.engineeringDeltaAfterDecision: Track and family registry entries per pathway, then regenerate the join and the closure ledger.
decisionSets.packetGenerationCurrentlyDisabled: 4 of 20 rows do not render today; payment is closed for all 20.

decisionSets.title: Build or bind a packet family before any legal question exists
decisionSets.currentPrimaryAuthority: auth-2026-08-19-owner-legal-approval-completed-output (approved, authorized) plus EXT-ADOPT-01 standing external counsel adoption of 2026-08-08
decisionSets.currentProductTreatment: Packet generation and payment are closed for every row in this set.
decisionSets.exactUnresolvedQuestion: None that counsel can answer. No packet family or track is reachable from these pathways, so there is no packet, no component set and no output for anyone to approve.
decisionSets.whyExistingAuthorityDoesNotResolveIt: No authority can. Counsel cannot approve a packet that does not exist, and asking would produce either a refusal or an approval of nothing.
proposedOptions: Build the packet family and then submit the completed output for review under the existing standing adoption.
Record the pathway as a non-packet service outcome, which needs no packet review.
decisionSets.recommendedProductDecision: Do not send these to counsel. Build or bind the family first; the existing standing adoption then covers the completed output on the same terms it already covers 72 pathways.
decisionSets.legalOwner: None. There is no artifact to review.
decisionSets.engineeringDeltaAfterDecision: Packet family construction or a non-packet service disposition per pathway.
